The Central Arizona Water Conservation District seat was uncontested and is not on the ballot. Board of Supervisors, County Attorney, Sheriff, Assessor, Recorder, Treasurer and School Superintendent were elected in 2024 and are not on this ballot. The state publicity pamphlet also lists Superior Court Judge Steven J. Fuller for retention, but Pinal County's candidate list does not, so he is not shown. Casa Grande has no city offices on this ballot. Check your official sample ballot for district races.

measures.title: APS Franchise Agreement
measures.summary: Asks Casa Grande voters to approve a 25-year franchise agreement with Arizona Public Service Company (APS) to build, operate and maintain its electric utility facilities in city rights-of-way. The current agreement, approved in 2002, expires in April 2027. Under the proposed agreement, which would begin April 2, 2027, APS would pay the city a franchise fee of 2% of its revenues from electricity sold or delivered within city limits.
measures.yesMeans: The city would approve the 25-year franchise agreement allowing APS to use city rights-of-way for its electric utility.
measures.noMeans: The proposed franchise agreement with APS would not be approved.
